title: Sean Payton takes over play-calling duties on offense for the Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton takes over play-calling duties on offense for the Broncos
sources.description: In the NFL, experience matters — especially at the coaching level. Few offensive minds have more experience calling plays in the NFL than Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton. Which is why it came as a surprise that he gave up that job after promoting Davis Webb to offensive coordinator. Unfortunately, Webb has faced a […]
